details.before: four semesters of Portuguese language (or equivalent)

all_of.source_quote: Building on a solid basis of four semesters
all_of.description: Four semesters of Portuguese (or equivalent) is a prerequisite for the minor, beyond the 20 required units.
all_of.note: The prerequisite language sequence is not part of the 20-unit minor count.

all_of.source_quote: select two of the following three courses
all_of.description: Select two of PORT 300, PORT 302, PORT 316 (8 units).

any.unresolved: Study Abroad courses and courses offered by other departments at USC where a Portuguese-speaking country or the Lusophone world is among the objects of study, as long as approved

all_of.source_quote: select three from the following list
all_of.description: Select three elective courses (12 units) from the listed Portuguese/Luso-Brazilian-related electives, study abroad courses, or approved courses from other departments with a Lusophone focus.
all_of.note: Courses should be selected with guidance of the program director; study abroad/other department courses qualify only if Lusophone-focused, which cannot be fully verified from a fixed list.

unclassified.source_quote: The Luso-Brazilian Studies minor will require 20
unclassified.why: Total unit count restating the sum of required (8) and elective (12) units; not an independent check.
